title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Surrender Fee Basis
content:
**1. Posting.** The voluntary surrender fee is posted once on the Repossession and Collateral Recovery case, on a case in recovered status, as an expense of type voluntary surrender fee dated on the posting date.

**2. Starting figure.** The standard voluntary surrender fee is the collateral class's voluntary surrender fee, read from the class expense schedule for the class on the case.

**3. Assembly.** The fee is assembled in this fixed order: any limit on the class surrender fee applies first, and any reduction and any credits are then subtracted from the limited fee without taking it below 25.00; the total is rounded to the cent.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Class on the case | read the class voluntary surrender fee | starting figure |
| Starting figure | apply any limit, then subtract any reduction and credits | an amount never below 25.00 |
| That amount | round to the cent | the fee posted |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- A hypothetical class whose voluntary surrender fee were 1,000.00, with nothing limiting it and nothing to subtract: the fee posted is 1,000.00.
- With hypothetical amounts, a limited fee of 140.00 less subtractions totalling 130.00 would leave 10.00; the fee does not go below 25.00, so 25.00 is posted.
